text: TELUS is a TSX/NYSE-listed Canadian telecom with a dispersed public shareholder base and no state owner; it files with the SEC as a foreign private issuer. The Vancouver Whitecaps front deal is private corporate money. Human-rights exposure is ordinary telecom supply chain (Huawei/network equipment) and privacy conduct.
short: TELUS is a TSX/NYSE-listed Canadian telecom with a dispersed public shareholder base and no state owner; it files with the SEC as a foreign private issuer.
